body: Use case stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D fantasy CHARACTER CUTOUT atlas. Arcane Vanguard clean cel-shaded painted fantasy, dark contours, restrained material detail. Iron Clan Spotter: human artillery observer with round blue-lensed goggles, simple grey steel helmet, charcoal grey padded uniform, leather crossbelts, brown gloves and boots, short dark slate cape. Spyglass and tripod separate, not on the body. Exact portrait1024x1536 layout: SIXcolumns TWELVErows. Every column is a different true facing: E,rightprofile; SE,frontright; SW,frontLEFT; W,leftprofile; NW,rearleft; NE,rearRIGHT with back of head visible. 72 SEPARATE parts. Rows top to bottom HEAD, torso without head or arms, rear mantle/cape, pelvis/belt, left upperarm, right upperarm, left forearm withhand, right forearm withhand, leftleg withoutboot, rightleg withoutboot, leftboot, rightboot. Neutral straight parts. Generous empty gap between all pieces; heads MUST NOT touch torsos, no limbs attached to torsos. No assembled character, weapons, text, labels, grid, scenery, background or shadows. Truly alpha-transparent background.
equipment: Use case stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D fantasy Iron Clan equipment cutouts, clean celshaded painted art with crisp contours, brass/iron/wood materials. THREE ROWS six columns. Row1 short brass spyglass tube with blue lens pointingUP, sixrotated views. Row2 wooden tripod base WITHOUT telescope, three legs open, sixrotated views. Row3 compact flare pistol steel+wood barrel pointingUP, sixrotatedviews. Separateobjects, nopeople/hands, eighteenpieces. Landscape1536x1024, exactequalcolumns, alpha-zero gaps, no background, no shadows, no labels, no frames.
effects: Use case stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D fantasy visual effect sheet for spotter. Clean celshaded painted style. Exact6columns4rows, every row6 successiveframes. Four rows six animationframes each: small steel/gold ranged shot pointingRIGHT; subtle impact sparks; golden circular scout flare with eye-like lens glint; grey dust arrival puff. Landscape1536x1024. Eachframecentered insideequalcell with largeemptytransparentmargins. No words, grids, background or backdropglow.
